learned: 2026-10-05, by hand: 186 products, 202 variants. The bare domain answers 429 with a bot check; www does not.
notes: Titles are 'Strain | [Live Resin Infused | Kief Coated | Live Resin] | Format Size | Pack', except the effect gummies, which lead with the line: 'Calm | Peach Gummies | 10pk'.
A gummy title gives the pack, not the dose; every product page says 10mg THC per gummy, so the 10-packs are 100mg. A pack of any other count falls through to unparsed on purpose.

The title is more reliable than product_type: pre-roll packs are typed 'Flower' ('Witches Brew | Live Resin Infused | 1/2 Gram Pre-Rolls | 5pk'), and seven real products have no product_type at all. So format words in the title decide first.

title.why: the site renamed its Gorilla Glue vapes GG4 (handle gorilla-glue-vape-cartridge-1g, tag 'Gorilla Glue'); every store still sells them as Gorilla Glue, so a GG4 entry matched nothing while store-only Gorilla Glue copies held the listings. Vapes only: the Kief Coated Gorilla Glue pre-roll is still Gorilla Glue on the site.
the one title that puts the line first: 'Live Resin Infused Super Bud | Half Gram Pre-Rolls | 5pk'

the plain whole-flower pre-rolls (1g singles, 7 x 0.5g tins). The site files the singles under its 'Non-Infused Pre-Rolls | 1-Pack' collection, apart from 'Infused Pre-Rolls | 1-Pack'; every 7pk is whole flower ('Ingredients: Whole cannabis flower') and no infused 7pk exists.
